_comment: Adversarial design-review efficacy ledger. Every figure here is a proxy: defects PREVENTED are unobservable because the counterfactual is invisible. Read by eye, sorted by surface_call_sites; do not fit a model. Holdout rows (holdout=true) are a separate population - a narrowing the holdout does not support is reverted. This file is append-only: post-hoc counters (e.g. escapes) are corrected by appending a superseding row for the same spec_path+commit_sha, never by editing this file - a reader takes the LAST such row.
